feeds.title: The Fat Rum Pirate
feeds.description: The Fat Rum Pirate is the rum blog that offers an unsophisticated review of the world of rum.

feeds.title: Rumming
feeds.description: Rumming can be described as a fun experience, which involves a bit more than drinking rum; it is the appreciation of the rum. It is origin, characteristics and history, and the journey of discovering new rums.

feeds.title: The Lone Caner
feeds.description: The Lone Caner is an offshoot from the Liquorature book club, where the original rum reviews were posted.

feeds.title: The Rum Barrel Blog
feeds.description: The Rum Barrel Blog is a blog about rum by Alexandru Sandu. He writes rum reviews and personal opinions to help educate others about the intricacies of rum. He is a cocktail bartender and rum enthusiast based in London.

feeds.title: The Rum Company Blog
feeds.description: A one-stop-shop for everything rum, providing helpful taste notes, the latest rum news, mixer recommendations, and cocktail recipes. The Rum Company is a dedicated online rum shop selling rums from all over Britain.

feeds.title: Craft Rum Club
feeds.description: Covers the latest rum news, rums of the month, and cocktail recipes. Craft Rum Club is a UK-based rum subscription service of premium crafted rums from around the world.
